authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality artistic rendering but contains specific AI artifacts. The paws of the central and right lions show significant fusion with the grass and lack distinct digit definition (melting artifact). The rear paw of the leftmost lion also lacks clear grounding geometry. Mane texture transitions from detailed strands to smooth painted patches near the neck. Despite these structural defects in the lower body/limbs, the facial anatomy and overall composition are strong. The purple coloration is an intentional stylistic choice, not an artifact.
key_defects: Paw fusion with grass/lack of digit definition on central and right lions
Melting artifact in leftmost lion's rear paw/grounding
Mane texture inconsistency (strands to smooth patches)
Tail tuft not visible/verifiable due to occlusion
